verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an API-driven data product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no batch or bulk endpoint, and no way to refresh, relink or act on many accounts in a single operation. The one-event-per-account webhook behavior for multi-account linking is an adjacent feature, and the Stripe-wide MCP server and CLI are platform tooling; neither documents bulk operations for Financial Connections.
